description.short: Chat with your Ergon team right from Teams.
description.full: Chat with your Ergon team right from Teams. The app only works in a one-on-one chat with it: it does not join group chats or channels. To use it, you need Ergon installed, and you link your Teams account to it with a code: the app shows the code in this chat and you type it in Ergon, under Connections › Teams. From then on, what you write here goes to your own team in Ergon, and the replies, the confirmations (with approve and reject buttons) and the alerts about what needs you arrive in this chat. When Ergon is closed, the app replies right away that it got the request and keeps it, encrypted, for up to 7 days until Ergon opens. The app does not read other chats, email or Microsoft 365 files: it only receives the messages sent to it. For now the app replies in Portuguese. To unlink your Ergon account, type "desligar".
